docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• A ROM of Super Smash Bros. Melee
  • An xDelta patching tool (see below)

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text: Each mod on this site comes as an xDelta patch file. Follow the steps below to install.

docs.title: Step 1: Download xDelta Patcher
docs.text: Download one of these tools: - DeltaPatcher (Windows/Mac/Linux) - Download - xDelta UI (Windows) - Simple GUI tool - Command Line (Advanced users) - See xDelta patching guide

docs.title: Step 2: Download the Mod Patch
docs.text: Visit any mod page and download the xDelta patch file.

docs.title: Step 3: Apply the Patch
docs.text:
1. Open your xDelta patcher
  2. Select the original ROM file
  3. Select the xDelta patch file
  4. Choose output location for patched ROM
  5. Click patch and wait for completion

docs.title: Step 4: Play!
docs.text:
Load your patched ROM in Dolphin Emulator or your preferred method.

Need more help? See xDelta Patching Explained

docs.title: Patch won't apply / Checksum errors
docs.text:
Problem: Patcher says "Checksum mismatch" or patch won't apply.

Solution: 1. Verify you have the correct original ROM version 2. Delete the patch file and re-download it 3. Try a different xDelta tool (e.g., DeltaPatcher vs command line) 4. Ensure the ROM file hasn't been corrupted

docs.title: ROM won't load in emulator
docs.text:
Problem: Patched ROM won't open or crashes on startup.

Solution: 1. Verify the patch completed successfully 2. Check the output ROM file size (should be similar to original) 3. Try the ROM in a different emulator version 4. Ensure you patched the correct original ROM version

docs.title: Game freezes or crashes during play
docs.text:
Problem: The mod crashes mid-game.

Solution: 1. This may be a known issue - check the mod's page for notes 2. Try the ROM on a different emulator 3. Update your emulator to the latest version 4. Report the issue to the mod creator with details

docs.title: Still stuck?
docs.text:
• Read the specific mod's page for any known issues
  • Check the Installation Guide again
  • Ask the community for help

If you discover a fix, please share it!

docs.title: What is xDelta?
docs.text: xDelta is a tool that stores only the differences between the original ROM and the modified version. This makes patch files incredibly small compared to distributing entire ROM files.

docs.title: Why xDelta?
docs.text:
• Small File Size - Patches are often <100MB vs 700MB+ for full ROMs
  • Legal - Distributes changes, not copyrighted material
  • Easy to Use - Simple graphical tools available

docs.title: Using DeltaPatcher (Recommended)
docs.text:
1. Download DeltaPatcher
  2. Open DeltaPatcher
  3. Click "Choose Source File..." and select your original ROM
  4. Click "Choose Patch File..." and select the .xdelta file
  5. Choose output location for your new ROM
  6. Click "Apply Patch"
  7. Wait for completion (can take a few minutes)

docs.title: Using Command Line (Windows/Mac/Linux)
docs.text:
xdelta3 -d -s original_rom.iso patched_rom.iso patch.xdelta

Replace: - original_rom.iso with your original ROM filename - patched_rom.iso with desired output filename - patch.xdelta with the patch filename

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
"Checksum mismatch" error? - Your original ROM may be corrupted - Download/extract the patch again - Ensure ROM is unmodified

Patch stuck or running slowly? - DeltaPatcher can take 5-15 minutes - Do not close the program - Ensure you have enough disk space (3-4GB free)

Still having issues? - Check the original ROM is the correct version - Try a different patching tool - Ask for help in the community
